# #5039: Patch: every card whose text acts while it is in play prints "Aura:"
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

## Why

§6.2 defines **Aura** as an "effect while in play" (the static modifier layer, §10.4), and 150 card faces in `crates/cards/catalog.json` print it the same way: `Aura: <text>` at the start of the line (Core #1 Big D-fender, Core #46 Suppressive Aura, M #65 Keymaster Keenus, …). But a few dozen faces print the same kind of standing text with no `Aura:`, so the same rule reads two ways depending on the card. A first scan (text only, so it misses some and wrongly includes others) finds, for example:

| Card | Line without `Aura:` |
|---|---|
| Core #73 Anti-oneshot Armor (Field Spell) | "Your hero can't take more than {cap} damage at a time." and, Radiant, "Your hero has Armor {armor}." |
| Core #84 Going Long (Field Spell) | "Your hero has Armor {armor}." |
| S #148 Alteran Reach (Field Spell) | "Your first travel each turn is free." |
| IA #95 The Botnet (Field Spell) | "Your Units have +{buff}/+{buff} for each other friendly Unit." |
| IA #118 The Recursionist | "Your Death triggers and Reborns happen twice[, and your Units have Reborn]." |
| IA #152 Rate Limiter | "Your opponent can't attack with more than three Units each turn." |
| IA #187 Fine-Tuner | "Your cards that started in your opponent's deck cost ({discount}) less." |
| IA #191 Ground Truth | "Your opponent plays with their hand revealed to you[…]." |
| IA #218 Thousand Faces (Field Spell) | "Your face-down cards can't be destroyed." |
| C+ #19.5 Bot Loser (Radiant), C+ #69 Buff Billy | "This can't go Berserk.", "This is a 2X/2X." (a card's standing text about itself: decide, below) |

These rows are test cases for the pass, not its scope (docs/issues-and-patches.md, A task over every card).

## What to do

1. **Settle the rule.** Write in §6.2's Aura row which text prints `Aura:`: standing text that acts while the card is face-up and active on the field (the top of its pile, §3), on its own side, the other side or the heroes. **Not** an aura: a hand, deck or graveyard trigger ("While this is in your hand: …", the Hand aura row), a lasting effect a Spell leaves behind ("this turn", "your next Spell", "until your next turn"), a keyword (Taunt, Indestructible, …), a trigger or timing word (Cry, Start of turn, "Once per turn, when …", Activate), an Embiggened line, and a "While Berserk:"-style condition that already names when it holds. Decide standing text a card has about **itself** ("This can't go Berserk", "This is a 2X/2X", M #65's "Aura: Has N random combat keywords" is the precedent already printed) and write it down. Where the spec does not already decide this, the decision is a ruling note numbered from this issue's block, with its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
2. **The measure.** Go over every catalog card and token, both faces (Infinite Assault included), and group them by **what their scripts set**, not by similar-looking text: a script that sets a standing hook (`aura`, `cost_aura`, `static_flags`, `exile_auras`, `hero_guard`, `draw_limit`, `discard_guard`, `attack_mods`, `conditional_keywords`, `set_stat`, a field `replacements` entry, and any other `Script` field read while the card is in play) owns a line that must print `Aura:` under the rule from step 1. Also check the reverse: a face that prints `Aura:` whose script sets none of these, or whose line is really a trigger.
3. **Normalize the words.** For each face the measure flags: the `Aura: ` prefix in `catalog.json`'s text; the card's §8 row; its `zh` face in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` (`光环：`, `chinese-terms.json`); one pending fragment (`cargo jackioh patches …`) claiming every changed id, with its player note under `text` written by hand (docs/ADDING_CARDS.md §3). This is wording only: no number, keyword or script behaviour changes, so no `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row unless a script writes its own words into the state.
4. **Keep it normal (CLAUDE.md rule 15).** Add a test that fails when a card's script sets a standing hook from step 2 and its face text has no `Aura:` line, or prints `Aura:` with none, with a short allowlist whose every entry gives its reason. Then the next card added without the prefix fails CI rather than waiting for another pass.

## Deliverable

A table in the pull request with **a row for every face the measure flagged in either direction**: card, face, the line, verdict (`Aura:` added / already printed / not an aura) and why, plus a count of every face the measure checked. "Every card checked" on its own is not enough.

## Acceptance

- §6.2's Aura row states the rule; any ruling it takes has its note and a proving test, and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
- Every flagged face prints `Aura:` or appears in the table with a reason it does not; `catalog.json`, the §8 rows and the `zh` faces agree.
- The step 4 test runs per pull request and fails on a scripted standing hook printed without `Aura:` (prove it by removing one prefix locally).
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` are green, and so are the cards' and tools' tests.
